changeSet.author: Filmon
changeSet.comment: Drop all tables except insured, payers, role, privilege, role_privilege, app_user, providers and Liquibase/Flyway tracking tables.
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT table_schema, table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_type='BASE TABLE' AND table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name NOT IN ('insured','payers','role','privilege','role_privilege','app_user','providers','databasechangelog','databasechangeloglock','flyway_schema_history') LOOP EXECUTE format('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %I.%I CASCADE', r.table_schema, r.table_name); END LOOP; END $$;
changeSet.rollback: -- No automatic rollback. Recreate tables via prior changesets if needed. SELECT 1;
